A nice face paced game. Has some strong Quake vibes for anyone looking for a game like that.

The excitement lasted until end of chapter 2, it should have ended there. Later parts were clearly unpolished. It was just like one of the Ubisoft canned games. Will it be popular? Yes. Would I recommend it to my friends? No.
A neon infused, violent fever dream. While there are some issues, especially compared with the first, it's still a high octane, blood-pumping game!

This game is an absolute work of art! There is so much love and care that clearly went into bringing this game to life! From the animation to the music to the sound design to the gameplay to the story, all of it is so masterfully done! The world and monster designs are so inspired and each location and enemy feels unique! The gameplay is smooth as butter and incredibly enjoyable to play! I love Neva and your characters' adorable relationship and how much it grows over the course of the game! And every single frame looks like a painting! Just beyond gorgeous! 

This game is really best played as blind as possible and I cannot recommend playing it enough!!

An 11/10 for sure!

Besides the fact this game has no one playing it. My friend and I bought the game. We had a ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ blast. The bots do try to murder you if they are the killer. They do collect resources and hoard them sometimes. This game is fun to play with friends. A dead game is only dead until people revive it. Does it need some optimization? Yeah, a bit, there is a delay in when the game announces someone dies. A mic bug that's solved by leaving the lobby and coming back. Those are my biggest issues. However, I love the look of it cause it's like those old PS2 games honestly. I've seen worse graphics. This game is fun and we bought it on a sale. Major props to the Dev who kept putting out content and bug fixes when the game slowed down. Even put out a Halloween event. I hope it comes out this year too, cause I would like to play it with my friends.
Good  game, but the whole disguise mechanic where you dress up so people wont recognize you and they still recognize you anyway is BS
True successor of the SNES Megaman series with it's own style.
GREEDY, there is only 1 mission & u must buy the rest.

Racked up 650 hours in around two months of playing. Beware. It's got an amazing soundtrack, beautiful art, raunchy humor, and addicting gameplay. Truly, its a great game. Not great for those who are a bit squeamish, though.

I enjoyed the first game immensely and this was... alright. It lost a lot of what the first game had going for it. The art was very good, like usual which was awesome. The boss fights were rather bland and the gunplay was great if i didnt have to reload every 10 seconds or switch weapons because I already ran out of my very limited ammo. I got it significantly discounted in a game bundle so I can't complain about the price but I definitely wouldn't get it unless it was on sale.

Its an indie masterpiece. Music and story are awesome and the gameplay is very short and satisfying. Took me 8 hours to complete the game yet it feels like 80. 
Balancing was very good and it was not very difficult which makes it super fun for employed people.
Its worth your money and if you are a fan of solemn and somber settings this game is definitely for you.
Combat and spell variety is consistent and I have found every spell and weapon to be reasonably powerful.
It runs well on all platforms and has pixel art style which gives enormous performance boost.
Highly recommend 9/10!

If youre a fan of Killer Bean then get it rn coz the price while rise as the game gets more developed, whoever is developing the game i must say he is cooking.. and boy oh boy does it smell good, as a OG DMC fan i love how stylish you can be in combat, (one of the main reasons i got the game) he can pretty much do every cool thing he did in the Killer Bean Forever movie which is hilarious and awesome at the same time, boss fights are supringsingly really good too and so is FPP mode, my only issue is the performance even tho i havea somewhat high end gaming pc the fps cant stick to 60 in some stages especially the mech stages for some reason, also please add Vagan if youre reading this mr Developer since i know u mentioned Jet bean being added in the early access dev post. This game is gonna be fire once its done and polished i know. :)

Black Mesa is a fantastic fan remake of the original game of Half Life, great graphics, music soundtrack, lots of action, breaths new life to a familiar classic. some minor changes here and there but for the most part still just as great as the original. high replay value. worth the buy

Truly fantastic art style and creature design, unfortunately the controls are janky and unresponsive, this culminates in death's that instead of feeling like its your own fault you feel like the game is screwing you, for that reason I cannot recommend this game which is a pity.

A very beautiful and disturbing game set in Scandinavian folklore.
Short game, around 4-5h, easy puzzles, but enjoyable in graphics and setup.

Finally got around to blasting through this game after having it sit in my library for awhile. Light spoilers ahead.

 I really liked how the game went about the dual perspectives of both Kay and Catherine. Seeing from both povs, as Catherine continued to get further in the weeds, and Kay just trying to piece together just what the hell was going on, was really well done. I also liked how creepy & crackheaded Pawpaw was, great character. 

Overall, if you vibe with Disco Elysium-ish, mixed with old point-and-click adventure games, and dig cyberpunk-ish settings along with memorable characters, this is the game for you. Cop it when it's on sale for sure. It's not very long though! But that's A-ok in my book.
if you want to be john wick with a tiny teeny mix of max payne then this is the game for you.

The original and GOAT Battle Royale. What an absolute blast I use to have on this game back when it first came out with the boys. I mean, basically just a dressed up running simulator but still, so fun.
do not buy if you want to paly it with other people in the campagin as there is no campagin coop

Beautiful, game, storytelling, and immersion- Absolutely MUST be played with headphones, a whole different experience.

There were some complaints about the combat, but I loved it- I thought it was really heavy and immersive, makes you really feel like you're a relatively small woman fighting to overpower forces much larger than her.

Dont recomend the game, the difficulty is in a point in which is not even enjoyable, and just makes it tedious, so much that not even winning is as pleasent as it could have been. That mixed with the raw controls and forgetable story makes it not too enjoyable experience.

There’s a reason I refer to my Steam Deck as a $500 Balatro machine. Sure I play other games in my library but no game is as addictive and easily accessible as Balatro. It’s the perfect game to play casually on the couch while watching tv. That is until the numbers start to go brrrr and you lock in for the run. Laughably I put in over 58 hours before I found the right combination of Jokers and suit levels to finally win my first run. The 57 hours it took me til that I was unbothered that I’d yet to complete a run try as I might. Why go so long without winning? Because the game is so simple a concept to learn yet so addictive to master it just gets its hooks into you. 

Just get the game.

If you have friends, don't play this game.
Competitive is the only way to get queued with people that are not just straight-up trolling or instalocking DPS. Unfortunately you can't queue with more than three people for placements and after having the worst matchmaking for those matches you can't even queue properly with more than two players due to bugs and the strict matchmaking process.

This game is just too unoptimized to justify sinking so many hours into it, especially because you get kept out if you play with more than two players. This is probably the worst team-multiplayer game I've played in my entire life.
horrible soulless game, loading screen simulator, wish they never tried to do this and stuck with Fallout - we'd have had some great games MAYBE instead of this dumpsterfire

The game is good when you turn off that eyesore bloom + grain effect. Skill tree could use some movement tech, some weapons could have better sounds and the idea of defeating an eldritch god as an ordinary human is hilarious, devs had to severely downsize Cthulhu to make it possible. Even with these flaws the overall experience is worth it.
Why spend money on rage room, when you can just play this game with your friends? 10/10 game, made me crashout several times. Didn't know I needed those crashouts

Really good. If you like off world adventure or Limbo/Inside/Far: Lone Sail, you'll love this game. It's a bit of sci-fi + fantasy + adventure. The music pairs well. You're not only playing a game but you're having a really epic cinematic experience. 

Easy to pick up and not difficult to master. It's a beautiful game. Any of the scenes could be a wallpaper!

Highly recommend!

Just writing this review for people who may not enjoy the extreme amount of cutscenes in this game.

I'll pick this up when it is $20 or less, but in the opening hour of gameplay, I was just walking around between cutscenes for around 4 minutes. That wasn't worth the price tag for me personally.

Islets is a fun and concise metroidvania. It has the classic Kyle Thompson vibe and presentation combined with smooth gameplay. The airship sections could have been expanded upon but there isn't much to critique overall. Exploration, combat, and bosses are competently crafted for a quick adventure. This is probably my least favorite release from Kyle Thompson, but he just doesn't make bad games so Iselts is still solid.

Amazing game, incredible design and music. But bah gawd is it really difficult with its bosses. I've had to look up cheese strats online to beat a few of them. The skill level requirement reaches peak at times.

This is genuinely one of the best metroivanias I have ever played! I love the art style a lot and the characters are very cool. The platforming is very fun and the boss fights are the perfect skill level for me! (I suck at boss fights). This game has features within platforming that are unique which i haven't seen in any other game which i really appreciated. This game is very fun and I'd highly recommend checking it out!!

Visually very appealing, and game mechanics are nice.

It's fun and all, but if you haven't played Hollow Knight, make sure you play this game first otherwise you keep thinking to yourself "It's not as fun as Hollow Knight" mid-game constantly.

It has its own charms though.
this is by far the best lego batman game i've ever played (i have 100% completion on the first 2 games btw)
great comic base game that i love lots. better make darkness 3

This game is an embarrassing representation of the state of Halo as a franchise. Instead of putting out the hundred fires left in the company's nearly 16(!) year tenure, they've elected to make a lazy, thoughtless, cash-grabbing soulless remake of a game that understands NOTHING about what made the originals good. The company didn't earn a remake. May God have mercy on their souls.

Almost a year and a half later and we still haven't gotten any stability/optimization patches. In fact no patches since July 2025. The game is borderline unplayable without anything short of the best specs on the market the moment you leave the sewers.
Other than unskippable dialogue scenes and ♥♥♥♥♥♥ forced stealth sections phenomenal game
